bot.autonomy_already_paused: The autonomy of the table was already paused.

bot.cmd_lock: locks the Mestre: nothing runs until the Guildmaster unlocks it
bot.cmd_revoke_all: revokes all delegations and temporary table rules (the Guildmaster only)
bot.cmd_start: Pair with a code or see the help
bot.cmd_unlock: unlocks the Mestre (the Guildmaster only, with the PIN)
bot.cmd_workspace: shows and changes the active campaign
bot.decree_ask_pin: To confirm I will ask for your PIN ({{why}}).
bot.decree_locked: the Mestre is locked: only the Guildmaster unlocks it
bot.decree_no_proposal: this proposal expired or was already answered
bot.decree_not_allowed: your level does not revoke this decree
bot.decree_not_author: only the author of the order confirms
bot.decree_not_saved: I did not save the decree: {{reason}}
bot.decree_pin_cancelled: Wrong or expired PIN: the proposal was cancelled and nothing was saved.
bot.decree_pin_not_revoked: Wrong or expired PIN: the decree was not revoked.
bot.decree_suspended: It was suspended: it opposes another decree of the same level, and both authors and the Guildmaster were told.
bot.decrees_none: No active decree in your campaigns.
bot.delegation_ending: Delegation {{number}} ({{summary}}) ends on {{moment}}. Renewing counts for the default validity of the campaign (up to 30 days), with your PIN.
bot.digest_not_open: this suggestion was already answered or is gone
bot.digest_owner_only: only the Guildmaster answers a suggestion
bot.full_text_below: (the full text is in the file below)
bot.github_app_not_ready: The Grand Master App is not ready yet: the Guildmaster needs to finish creating it.
bot.github_connect: To connect your GitHub, open {{uri}} and type the code {{code}} (valid until {{until}}). Sign in with the account registered for you. I will tell you here when the connection is done; the token goes straight to the vault and does not pass through this conversation.
bot.github_connected: GitHub connected. The Mestre now uses your personal credential where it applies; you can disconnect whenever you want.
bot.github_denied: The authorization was refused on GitHub. If it was a mistake, send /github again.
bot.github_device_flow_off: The Grand Master App has the device flow turned off on GitHub: the Guildmaster needs to turn on the Enable Device Flow option in the settings of the App.
bot.github_expired: The code expired before the authorization. Send /github to ask for another.
bot.github_failed: I could not connect GitHub now. Try again in a few minutes; the Guildmaster gets the detail in the log.
bot.github_mismatch: The GitHub account that authorized is not the one registered for you. Nothing was kept; sign in with the right account and send /github again.
bot.github_no_credential: Your registration cannot connect GitHub now (user suspended, removed or Observer).
bot.github_no_login: Your registration has no GitHub login: ask an Administrator to fill it in and try again with /github.
bot.github_no_secret: The secret of the Grand Master App is not in the vault: the Guildmaster needs to recreate the App (see the panel).
bot.github_no_workspace: You do not act in any campaign yet: ask an Administrator. The personal GitHub is used only in the campaigns where you act.
bot.github_not_ready: The bot is not ready yet; try again in a moment.
bot.gm_notice:
Notice from the Grand Master (agent text, not verified):
{{body}}
bot.guild_excluded_done: Machine excluded: it wipes the vault and is not promoted.
bot.guild_exclusion_undone: Exclusion undone: the machine gets the vault again.
bot.guild_level: Your level does not exclude machines.
bot.guild_not_changed: I did not change the exclusion: {{reason}}
bot.guild_not_listed: I could not list the machines now: {{reason}}
bot.guild_only_citadel: Only the Citadel lists the machines of the Guild.
bot.guild_only_citadel_changes: Only the Citadel changes the exclusion of a machine.
bot.guild_pin_wrong: Wrong or expired PIN: nothing was changed in the Guild.

bot.guild_waiting: Waiting for the Guildmaster (the answer is in the approval request):
bot.kind_not_accepted: I do not accept this kind of message. I can receive text, voice, audio, photo and document. To send a video, send it as a file.
bot.language_current: Language in use: {{language}}. Choose the language of the messages:
bot.left_chat: The bot was added to a chat that is not private and left it.
bot.level_no_talk: With your level you do not talk to the Grand Master. {{commands}}
bot.level_not_allowed: Your level does not allow it: {{reason}}

bot.lock_level: your level does not lock the Mestre
bot.locked_kept: The Mestre is locked: your message is kept and goes to the Grand Master when the Guildmaster unlocks it.
bot.locked_not_kept: The Mestre is locked and I could not keep the message. Send it again later.
bot.locked_queries_only: The Mestre is locked: I only answer queries and /destravar.
bot.marked_mistake: Decision #{{id}} marked as a mistake by {{name}}.
bot.marked_to_forbid: To forbid, ask the Grand Master for a decree.

bot.needs_question: Write the question that whoever asked will answer.
bot.no_commands: There are no commands for your level.
bot.not_delivered: I could not deliver the message to the Grand Master. Try again in a moment.

bot.only_owner_revokes_all: only the Guildmaster revokes all delegations
bot.pause_autonomy_level: your level does not pause the autonomy of a table
bot.pause_autonomy_unavailable: pausing autonomy is not available now
bot.pause_unavailable: pausing a table is not available now
bot.pin_locked: The PIN is locked for a while.
bot.pin_locked_err: your PIN is locked for a while

bot.rule_not_yours: this rule is not of a campaign of yours
